bio: Malcolm James McCormick, known as Mac Miller, was an American rapper, singer, and multi-instrumentalist from Pittsburgh revered for his artistic evolution and deeply soulful musicianship.

name: Arctic Monkeys
genre: Indie Rock / Garage Rock / Post-Punk Revival
bio: Arctic Monkeys are an English rock band formed in Sheffield in 2002, led by Alex Turner, achieving worldwide acclaim with AM and 7 Brit Awards.
